dedupe_keys.name: thailand france mango air cargo temperature humidity and quality measurements

description: This collection follows a fully loaded air-cargo unit containing 148 mango cartons from Thailand to the INRAE FRISE laboratory in France. INRAE and King Mongkut’s Institute of Technology Ladkrabang measured air and fruit temperature and humidity every five minutes during an 86.2-hour shipment, then assessed mass loss, colour, acidity, sugar and appearance during storage. Repository coverage is 18 April–3 May 2023. Recherche Data Gouv provides text measurements, tables, photographs and R material free under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The metadata describe twenty-five instrumented cartons and fifteen-degree storage, whereas the article reports thirty-one cartons and sixteen degrees. These unresolved discrepancies and the single shipment are limitations for comparison. Modellers could calibrate cargo heat-transfer or cold-chain quality simulations; model-openfoam provides a related fluid-dynamics environment. The repository lists 562 unrestricted files and child identifiers under this dataset. No measurement, image or script was downloaded, and the published temperature and carton counts were not reconciled by inspecting payloads.
